program.section_heading: Firefighter Academy - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - MAS669/C/MCE669
outcomes: Perform skills that meet National Fire Protection Association Standard 1001 for firefighter and California State Fire Marshal Standards for Firefighter 1.
Demonstrate written and verbal communications skills required for entry-level firefighter positions.
Analyze emergency and hazardous conditions that are inherent to the firefighting profession.

notes: The page prints one section for both the A.S. Degree and the Certificate of Achievement; the degree shares the same Required Courses list (29 units) and the same Program Learning Outcomes, recorded here for the A.S. Degree.
The section heading is printed three times; the third variant lists program codes MAS669/MAS669B/MAS669C/MCE669.
Catalog codes are printed with hyphens (FIT-S3A, FIT-S3, EMS-50, EMS-51); they were matched to closed-list entries FIT S3A, FITS3, EMS50 and EMS 51 despite spacing/hyphen differences.
The degree requires general education and other graduation requirements, but no specific GE pattern is named in the text, so ge_pattern is null.
The closed list stores no units for EMS50 and FITS3; the catalog prints 5.00 and 21.50 respectively.
